title: airlock instrumentation config — the boot(config) project config (experimental, NOT frozen)
description: The project JSON config `boot(config)` (adapters/eds/index.js) consumes: which connectors to instrument (+ their ids/endpoints) and the top-level consent/payload governance. Modelled as the DISCRIMINATED UNION it is: each connector entry's `type` selects one of ga4 / pixel / helix-rum / alloy (oneOf on a `type` const), with a nested `vendor` (meta / linkedin / bing) under `pixel`, and helix-rum's governance-free shape (spec 022 exempts RUM from consent/denylist). Experimental — explicitly NOT frozen: the real-site validation exercises this shape and a later config-surface freeze (a follow-on ADR extending ADR-0017) pins what settles (this is NOT one of architecture.md's five frozen contract surfaces). ALLOY COVERAGE (spec 033-02 + 033-03): Adobe/alloy is covered for BOTH the ANALYTICS vertical (a {type:"alloy"} entry boots alloy via bootAlloy through the Edge interact; the stock @adobe/alloy SDK bundle is ADOPTER-SUPPLIED via `bundleUrl`, ADR-0016 — airlock does NOT ship it) AND PERSONALIZATION / decisions-as-data (spec 033-03 + 034-02): the interact's decisions fill pre-reserved CWV-safe boxes via reserveSpace — declared with N `placements` entries of arbitrary scopes (the connector carries them as `decisionScopes`; the host maps each returned decision to its box by scope). So MVP6's named 'GA4 + Adobe/alloy' supported subset is covered for BOTH analytics and personalization. Reference schema only: `boot(config)`'s RUNTIME validation is a lightweight hand-rolled SUBSET (no ajv in the shipped bundle); ajv validates THIS schema in the contracts dev harness (npm run validate).

connectors.description: The connectors to instrument, in order. `boot(config)` boots each and returns a composite over them. `{type:"alloy"}` covers BOTH the analytics vertical (spec 033-02) and personalization (spec 033-03 + 034-02, via N `placements` entries of arbitrary scopes).

consent.description: ADR-0007 consent vector: purpose name -> state (e.g. {"analytics_storage":"granted","ad_storage":"denied"}). Applies to the CONSENT-GOVERNED connectors (GA4, pixels); helix-rum is EXEMPT (spec 022 — RUM is not consent-gated). An open taxonomy, so purpose names are unconstrained; values are strings resolved case-insensitively (granted/denied; anything else -> pending).

consentStrict.description: spec 017-03 AC3 — a strict / no-processing regime for the consent-governed connectors.

payloadDenylist.description: spec 019-01 (ADR-0012) — extra payload keys stripped before egress, merged with the always-on built-in default. Applies to consent-governed connectors; helix-rum is exempt.

connector.description: A single connector entry — a discriminated union on `type` (ga4 / pixel / helix-rum / alloy). alloy covers analytics (spec 033-02) AND personalization (spec 033-03, via `placements`).

ga4Connector.description: GA4 (analytics). Consent-governed; the top-level consent/consentStrict/payloadDenylist are threaded in. GA4's measurement_id/api_secret live in the collect endpoint URL, not as a config id.

endpoints.description: Optional collect endpoint(s); defaults to the placeholder GA4 MP collect URL.

ctx.description: Optional pre-sourced identity snapshot; when absent, sourced host-side from the _ga cookie (004-03).

pixelConnector.description: An ads/remarketing pixel. Consent-governed (ad_storage). Nested discrimination on `vendor` (meta / linkedin / bing), each requiring its own vendor id.

conversionId.description: Optional LinkedIn conversion id for the `lead` event.

helixRumConnector.description: helix-rum (RUM authority). GOVERNANCE-FREE shape (spec 022): NOT consent-gated, no payload denylist — the top-level consent/consentStrict/payloadDenylist do NOT gate or strip it, and it carries none of those fields itself.

alloyConnector.description: Adobe/alloy — ANALYTICS (spec 033-02) + PERSONALIZATION (spec 033-03): boots the stock @adobe/alloy Web SDK in airlock's classic chamber, egresses one Analytics pageView via the Edge interact, AND (033-03) delivers Target personalization as data — the interact's `__view__` decisions fill a pre-reserved CWV-safe box via reserveSpace (see `placements`). Requires `bundleUrl` AND a datastream id (`datastreamId`, or its `datastream`/`edgeConfigId` alias) — alloy configure() needs it AND it is the config-integrity tenant pin (spec 015 / ADR-0011: the `configId` the honest Edge interact carries; a re-tenant to an attacker org is HELD at the seam). The endpoint-ceiling pins the grounded interact FLOOR (016-02). Consent-governed (analytics_storage + personalization) — the top-level consent/consentStrict/payloadDenylist are threaded in (the strict seam gate: a denied OR pending governing purpose DROPS the WHOLE interact — so a personalization denial holds analytics too, the 020-02 all-or-nothing behavior). The stock SDK bundle is ADOPTER-SUPPLIED via `bundleUrl` (ADR-0016 — airlock does NOT ship it; same-origin byte-pinned recommended, cross-origin supported). Personalization supports N placements of arbitrary scopes (spec 034-02): the connector carries the declared scopes on the interact (`decisionScopes`) and the host maps each returned decision to its box by scope; duplicate scopes are rejected.

bundleUrl.description: URL to the ADOPTER-SUPPLIED stock @adobe/alloy bundle the chamber importScripts (REQUIRED — ADR-0016; airlock does not ship it). Same-origin byte-pinned recommended; a cross-origin Adobe-CDN URL is supported with the stated integrity/CSP trade-off.

datastreamId.description: alloy configure() datastream id (the Edge config id).

context.description: alloy configure() context array (default [] — the chamber is headless, no ambient auto-collection).

placements.description: spec 033-03 + 034-02 — Target personalization placements (decisions-as-data → reserveSpace). N entries of ARBITRARY scopes (spec 034-02): the connector carries the declared `scope`s on the interact (`decisionScopes`) so alloy fetches each, and the host maps every returned decision to its box BY SCOPE. Each entry names a CWV-safe box airlock reserves BEFORE paint (loadEager, via reservePersonalization) and FILLS with that scope's decision HTML via reserveSpace once the lazy interact returns it. DUPLICATE scopes are REJECTED (`uniqueItems` catches identical entries here; the hand-rolled runtime validator additionally rejects any two placements sharing a `scope`, even with different selectors — the scope-keyed reserve/deliver maps would otherwise collapse last-wins). The per-scope Edge/Target RESPONSE is server behavior — rig-proven with a stub, live-Alloy creds-gated (013 pattern).

scope.description: The personalization scope (e.g. `__view__` for above-the-fold, or a named Target scope like `products`). Any non-empty string (spec 034-02 — multi-scope). Must be unique across `placements` (the scope-keyed map would otherwise collapse last-wins).

selector.description: CSS selector for the box to reserve + fill.

minHeight.description: Reserved box min-height (px) — sized before paint so the later fill causes no reflow (max-height/overflow:clip cap the box; 018-02).

prehide.description: Prehide the box content (visibility:hidden, still in flow) until fill or the reveal-backstop timeout (default true).

timeout.description: Prehide reveal-backstop timeout (ms) — a decision that never arrives still reveals the box.
